newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle trade near standstill - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle trade near standstill - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets were inactive near midday on Wednesday following hefty sales late Tuesday at higher prices, market sources said.
About 50,000 sold Tuesday late afternoon at $102.00 to mostly $104.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, steady to $2.00 higher than last week's top price.
Sales also were reported at $64.00 to $65.00 on a live basis, steady to $1.00 higher than the top last week.
Some bids at $104.00 were passed by owners asking $105.00 for remaining cattle. The week-to-date estimate was near 60,000 head following Tuesday's brisk trading, they said.
